authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) / Registrar of Companies

description.en: A Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) is a business structure that combines the flexibility of a partnership with the limited liability of a company. LLP registration is done under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008 through the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal. An LLP requires a minimum of two designated partners, at least one of whom must be a resident of India. LLPs are popular among professionals, startups, and small businesses.

verifiedConditions.claim: An LLP must have a minimum of two partners (designated partners). There is no maximum limit on the number of partners. At least two partners must be designated partners responsible for compliance.
At least one designated partner must be a resident of India, meaning a person who has stayed in India for at least 120 days during the preceding financial year.

unverifiedEligibility: Foreign nationals and foreign bodies corporate can be partners in an Indian LLP subject to FDI regulations and RBI approval.
A body corporate (company) can also be a partner in an LLP through a nominated representative.
Persons disqualified under Section 5 of the LLP Act cannot be designated partners.
Minors cannot be partners in an LLP.

requirements.claim: All designated partners must obtain a Designated Partner Identification Number (DPIN) or Director Identification Number (DIN). Application is made through MCA portal using Form DIR-3. DPIN and DIN are interchangeable for LLP purposes.
Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) of at least one designated partner who will sign the electronic forms on the MCA portal. The DSC must be registered on the MCA portal.

Name reservation through Form RUN-LLP (Reserve Unique Name for LLP) on MCA portal. The proposed name must be unique and not identical or similar to existing companies, LLPs, or trademarks. Up to two name choices can be submitted. Reserved name is valid for 90 days.

Form FiLLiP (Form for Incorporation of Limited Liability Partnership) must be filed on the MCA portal with details of the LLP including name, registered office address, partner details, business activities, and capital contribution.

LLP Agreement must be filed within 30 days of incorporation using Form 3. The agreement defines the mutual rights, duties, and obligations of partners and the LLP. It must be printed on stamp paper of the applicable value (varies by state).
Proof of registered office address — rental agreement/lease deed with NOC from landlord, or ownership documents. Utility bill (electricity/telephone) not older than 2 months as address evidence.
For each partner: PAN card, Aadhaar card, passport-size photograph, proof of address (Aadhaar/passport/voter ID/driving license), and consent to act as designated partner (Form 9).

processInformation.claim: Obtain DPIN/DIN for all designated partners through MCA portal (Form DIR-3) and register DSC of the signing partner on the MCA portal. These are prerequisites before filing incorporation forms.
File Form RUN-LLP on MCA portal to reserve a unique name for the LLP. The name must end with 'LLP' or 'Limited Liability Partnership'. The Registrar approves or rejects the name within 1-3 days.

processInformation.appliesTo: All LLP applicants with approved name
processInformation.claim: File Form FiLLiP on MCA portal with all required details and attachments. Pay the prescribed fee online. The Registrar reviews and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with LLPIN (LLP Identification Number) upon satisfaction.
File the LLP Agreement using Form 3 within 30 days of incorporation. The agreement must be on stamp paper and notarized. Failure to file within 30 days attracts a penalty of Rs. 100 per day.
Apply for PAN and TAN of the LLP. PAN can be applied concurrently with the incorporation form through the integrated process on MCA portal.

output.claim: A Certificate of Incorporation is issued by the Registrar of Companies containing the LLP name, LLPIN (LLP Identification Number), date of incorporation, and state of registration. The LLP is a body corporate from the date mentioned in the certificate. PAN and TAN are also allotted.

fees.claim: Name reservation through Form RUN-LLP costs Rs. 200. If the first name is rejected, resubmission attracts the same fee.

fees.applicability: LLP incorporation fee (depends on capital contribution)
fees.claim: LLP incorporation fee (Form FiLLiP) ranges from Rs. 500 to Rs. 5,000 depending on the total capital contribution of the LLP. For contribution up to Rs. 1 lakh, the fee is Rs. 500. For contribution above Rs. 10 lakhs, the fee is Rs. 5,000.
Filing fee for Form 3 (LLP Agreement) is Rs. 150. Additional stamp duty on the LLP agreement varies by state and is separate from the MCA filing fee.

processingTime.applicability: LLP incorporation from name reservation to certificate issuance
processingTime.claim: LLP incorporation typically takes 10-15 working days including name reservation (1-3 days), form processing (5-7 days), and certificate issuance. The timeline may vary based on MCA portal load and correctness of submitted documents. Rejections and resubmissions extend the timeline.

sources.title: Ministry of Corporate Affairs — LLP Registration Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The MCA portal provides the complete online framework for LLP incorporation including name reservation (RUN-LLP), incorporation (FiLLiP), and subsequent filings. Fee schedules, form requirements, and processing information are available on the portal.
claimsSupported: LLP registration is done through the MCA portal.
Forms required: RUN-LLP for name, FiLLiP for incorporation, Form 3 for agreement.
sources.uncertainty: MCA portal processes and fee structures are subject to periodic changes through notifications.

sources.title: Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008
sources.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The LLP Act, 2008 provides the legal framework for formation, operation, and dissolution of LLPs in India. Key provisions cover: minimum 2 partners, at least 1 resident designated partner, LLP agreement mandatory, body corporate from date of incorporation.
claimsSupported: At least one designated partner must be resident in India.
LLP Agreement must be filed within 30 days of incorporation.
LLP is a body corporate with perpetual succession.
sources.uncertainty: The LLP Act has been amended and rules are updated periodically. The latest amendments and rules should be verified.

limitations: This record covers the standard LLP incorporation process. Conversion from partnership firm or company to LLP is a separate process not detailed here.
FDI regulations and RBI approval requirements for foreign partners are not covered in detail.
Stamp duty for LLP agreement varies by state and is not specified here.
Annual compliance requirements (Form 8 and Form 11) are not covered.
Professional fees charged by Company Secretaries or CAs for facilitation are not included in the fee estimates.
The record does not cover LLP closure or winding-up procedures.
